MEET YOUR LOCAL DRIVER

Meet Budi.

For Budi, showing guests around Bali is about more than simply driving from one place to another.

Budi is a local Balinese driver who enjoys sharing the island’s scenery, culture and everyday life with visitors. He aims to make every trip feel relaxed, welcoming and personal — whether you want to see famous temples, explore rice terraces, visit a local village, find a great place to eat or simply enjoy the journey at your own pace.

With local knowledge of Bali’s roads, travel times and popular areas, Budi can help turn your ideas into a practical itinerary while still leaving room for spontaneous stops along the way. Couples, families, solo travellers and groups are all welcome.
